full_details: The morning was the children's hose, looked at and not bought. At four you sat on the step below her while she strung beans. You put thirty shillings in her lap. That's over the quarter's. She said it was. She counted the coins as she would count them from anyone, and tied them in her apron. She asked what was in the box in London that you lock twice. You told her to the shilling: twenty pound and eight, and what a share may bring between Bartholomew and Christmas if the Mayor lets you alone. You did not name a weekly rate. The house is dark, and a rate would have been a guess. She strung six beans and asked what it was for. You said a house, here. She told you not to promise one. You said not with twenty pound. She said she would know you had looked if you could tell her which. You had not looked. You said so. Your mother had heard all of it, and set a pan down, and did not speak. At the book you wrote the thirty shillings on their own line.
one_sentence: You put thirty shillings in Anne's lap and told her twenty pound and eight.
title: Put thirty shillings in Anne's lap
